description: This Java class implements a command strategy to handle modifications to loan applications identified by external ID. It processes batch requests, extracts relevant URL parameters, and delegates the update operation to the LoansApiResource, returning the appropriate batch response.

classes.name: ModifyLoanApplicationByExternalIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component implementing CommandStrategy to process batch requests that modify loan applications identified by external ID. It extracts URL parameters, calls the appropriate API, and constructs the batch response.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the batch request to modify a loan application by extracting URL parameters, invoking the LoansApiResource, and returning a BatchResponse with the API's result.
